purpose: Short machine-readable current context and routing for agents. This file is not project history.

canonical_read_order: relevant local AGENTS.md for touched package/app
one task-specific active doc when scope requires it
read_policy.history_read_condition: Read logs/archive only when explicitly asked for history, repeated-error debugging, regression archaeology, or old audit details.

current_context.active_branch_role: dev-deploy is the integration/deployment branch; synchronize fastlife_dev after tested merges. Production remains main-only.
current_context.worktree: Shared web catalog/workspace and typed API/application model capabilities integrated. Read Git for current commit and uncommitted changes.
current_context.dev_contour: DEV uses separate secrets, VPS, tunnel, VK group and payment configuration.
current_context.prod_contour: main deploys through GitHub Actions and immutable GHCR images with mandatory smoke.
current_context.loadtest_contour: Mock providers, payments and delivery only; no production hosts or paid calls.

recent_decisions: Website referrals use canonical account-owned codes, first-touch hashed 30-day browser intents and transactional new-account acceptance. Website counters are real and source=web only; activation/rewards stay disabled pending rules. No synthetic VK users or direct credit grants. Operational details: docs/runbooks/WEB_REFERRALS.md.

Google login/linking is disabled by default with ACCOUNT_OAUTH_GOOGLE_ENABLED=false and hidden in web UI; adapter code, credentials and bindings remain. Last-login protection counts configured usable methods, and profile/menu labels prefer the verified primary email.
DEV manual model smoke is explicitly authorized by the user: priced candidates run with dev-smoke status; production admission and paid-agent-call authorization remain unchanged.
Default context is intentionally small: AGENTS.md, .agents/state.json and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
docs/HANDOFF_CURRENT.md is the only active handoff slot; completed handoffs live under docs/archive/handoffs/.
RUNBOOK.md is an entrypoint; task details live under docs/runbooks/.
DEV and PROD envs must be compared by variable names without printing values.
Target account model: account_id owns billing, jobs, artifacts, history and referrals; VK/TG/email/phone/OAuth identities are login bindings.
Account identity schema, VK user backfill migrations and IdentityResolver runtime bridge exist; VK Bot/Mini App receive legacy users with account_id populated.
AccountService is the product-facing account boundary above IdentityResolver/accountauth: it returns safe profile/identity DTOs and routes verified link/unlink without exposing raw identity rows.
Account HTTP API is mounted under /account/*: GET /account/me, GET /account/identities and unlink return safe account DTOs; HTTP link remains fail-closed until method-specific verification exists.
VK Bot can link email/phone identities to the current account after use through IdentityResolver with explicit VK-button confirmation; no balance/history transfer is needed.
New login methods enter as verified assertions through accountauth -> IdentityResolver; email/password, phone OTP, Google, Apple, Telegram and VK ID all resolve to account_id through the same layer.

Account auth/link flows require verified assertions, hashed token/credential storage, PII-free safe refs, link/unlink audit, same-account actor checks and hashed Redis-backed rate-limit keys; merge remains blocked without a dedicated confirmed audit flow.

Email/password requires a verified email on the same account. Initial setup is insert-only; password mutation commits credential, audit, session revocation and notice enqueue atomically. Password login rechecks exact credential/email binding under the same account lock as mutation/unlink/rotation. Browser changes preserve only their active server session; recovery/legacy calls revoke all. Recovery/link/phone/backup codes are consumed atomically once; backup emails share the account password.

Accounts accept one primary and one backup email. Server roles follow verified binding creation order; legacy extras remain linked. Add/unlink/replace serialize on one account lock, and replacement proof binds the current backup version so stale tabs cannot overwrite newer addresses.

Browser password login and accepted registration confirm the cookie profile, then load a fresh localized document to replace cached guest UI. Failed sign-in records only safe stage/code/status/timing and UUID request metadata; temporary backend failures are distinct from invalid credentials.

Account identity rollout checks now cover old VK balance/jobs/payments visibility by account_id, implicit accounts for new VK users, idempotent email linking, conflict handling and ledger owner_account_id.

Email and phone linking use configured SMTP/HTTP delivery and fail closed when unavailable. Password/backup email changes enqueue verified-recipient security notices transactionally; bounded leased SMTP delivery retries independently, with one-day sent and seven-day pending retention and no PII logs.

Current business tables have additive account ownership columns for dual-read/dual-write: jobs, payment_intents, artifacts, conversations, referrals and billing credit/ledger surfaces. Subscriptions are target-model only until a real table/domain model exists.
DEV is the daily integration/testing contour; PROD secrets must not be copied from DEV.

YooKassa payment values are contour-specific: do not value-sync payments.dev.env and payments.prod.env, and do not force YOOKASSA_SECRET_KEY, YOOKASSA_SHOP_ID or YooKassa return URLs to match across DEV, PROD, .env and dev.env.
Provider calls remain isolated in workers/adapters; VK bot, Mini App and cmd/api must not call AI providers directly.
Billing remains ledger-based and payment top-ups require provider-verified webhook/reconciliation.

The standalone NeiroHub web platform uses one independently deployable Next.js application with public SSG/ISR routes, authenticated no-store/noindex routes, secure server-managed web sessions and a channel-neutral versioned /web/v1 Go API.
The shared /web/v1/models catalog feeds all web selectors and generation controls; API and application capabilities remain separate and never enable unwired inputs.
Registry records are typed by purpose. Stable admission serialization preserves the frozen legacy baseline; descriptions do not establish verified onboarding.

Current model integration/live DEV handoff is docs/HANDOFF_CURRENT.md (October 7); the September 21 handoff is archived. The verified video/history package is included in fastlife_dev; fetch/merge carries the code. DEV runtime recovery and deployment are separate operations.
active_priorities: Keep DEV and PROD deploy workflows aligned but isolated by secrets, tunnel, VK group and payment settings.
Run longer sustained load tests before claiming scale readiness.
Verify live YooKassa smoke before real-money confidence: payment.succeeded, payment.canceled, refund.succeeded, replay/idempotency and reconciliation.
Plan operational migration to external/managed Postgres, Redis and S3 before serious traffic.
Use protected PR/review flow for main; no force push.
Verify legacy model capabilities with dated provider evidence and authorized live checks before expanding supported inputs.
open_risks: DEV/PROD env drift is still possible if the parity allowlist becomes too broad or secret files are edited manually.
Real provider/payment smoke tests can spend money or touch external systems; require explicit approval and correct environment.
Mock load tests do not prove real provider quota or external API throughput.
Lot/FIFO attribution is still needed before automatic or partial refunds for already-spent credits.
Old archived handoffs may contain stale branch names or outdated priorities; do not treat them as current truth.
security_invariants: No secrets, tokens, auth headers, full launch params, prompt bodies, provider payloads, private artifact URLs or raw PII in git, logs, docs or chat.
VK handlers, Mini App BFF and cmd/api never call AI providers directly.
Billing is append-only ledger based; no direct balance mutation.
Payment redirect/confirmation URL is not proof of payment.
YooKassa top-up credits only through provider-verified webhook/reconciliation plus ledger.
Do not weaken auth, signature checks, moderation, billing, idempotency, TLS, webhook trust or production CORS.

subagent_policy.output_schema: status, findings file:line issue fix, changed_files/tests, residual_risks
